info.title: CF Meet Organizations Service internal API
info.description: Internal signed API of services/organizations (cfmeet.organizations), the first-party business organization authority (Blueprint v1.0 Sections 3-5, ADR 0056). Generated from and governed by docs/api/organizations-internal-v1.md. Every /internal/v1 route requires a packages/service-auth token whose issuer holds the stated permission in the receiver's trust bundle; replayed tokens are refused. The acting user (X-CF-Acting-User) is honoured only from callers holding organization.act-for-user. Never routed by public ingress. 1.1.0 (Blueprint Sections 6-7): teams and team members, typed organization policies with compare-and-swap and effective constraints, the role / capability matrix, team context in resolve / evaluate, policy-restricted capabilities (POLICY_RESTRICTED), verified technical-scope resolution and the operator provisioning retry; provisioning is off by default. 1.2.0 (Blueprint Section 12 follow-up, CAL-007 / ORG-012 / CAL-009): per-organization Calling service binding of the organization's technical scope (operator routes GET / PUT / DELETE /internal/v1/admin/organizations/{id}/scopes/primary/service-bindings/calling; Platform Access ids only, re-verified by Platform Access at use) and resolveScope answers serviceBindings.calling. 1.3.0 (final closure): organization event delivery to subscribed consumers over signed service HTTP (the Meeting Service, meeting-organization-events.apply) with the operator delivery status GET /internal/v1/admin/event-delivery and dead-letter replay POST /internal/v1/admin/event-delivery/replay (organization.administer); a Messaging service binding per organization scope (GET / PUT / DELETE .../service-bindings/messaging) carried by scopes/resolve as serviceBindings.messaging. 1.5.0 (ADR 0058 Amendment A2, automatic organization service bindings): with ORGANIZATIONS_SERVICE_BINDINGS_ENABLED the provisioning saga creates, reads back, verifies and records each organization's Calling and Messaging bindings through Platform Access (platform-identity.bind-organization-services) and the organization becomes READY only once both are verified; bindings are renewed and re-verified by reconciliation (drift: SERVICE_BINDING_DRIFT), revoked at Platform Access after archive; ServiceBinding gains source (AUTOMATIC / OPERATOR), verifiedAt and credentialExpiresAt; operator credential rotation POST .../service-bindings/{calling|messaging}/rotate (organization.administer). 1.8.0 (ADR 0064, CF Meet Apps; ORGANIZATIONS_APP_INSTALLS_ENABLED, default off): the policy section apps {installTier ADMINS | MEMBERS (default ADMINS), allowList [appId] | null (default null), userInstallsAllowed (default true)} (refused while the flag is off) and POST /internal/v1/organizations/{id}/app-install-check (organization-apps.evaluate, Meeting Service only): may this account install this app for the whole organization; off: 404 like any unknown route. 1.9.0 (ADR 0068, admin bridge): operator attribution (X-CF-Operator, X-CF-Approver, X-CF-Approval-Ref, X-CF-Intent-Digest) accepted only from cfmeet.admin-bridge and refused on every route from any other caller (403 ACTOR_NOT_ALLOWED); the admin bridge's operator reads GET /internal/v1/operator/organizations/{id} and its /members, /teams and /policies and GET /internal/v1/operator/audit-events (cross-organization, newest first, window at most 31 days), each requiring organization.operator-read and X-CF-Operator. 1.10.0 (ADR 0068 phase A4, admin bridge commands): with organization.administer and verified X-CF-Operator attribution (cfmeet.admin-bridge only), the bridge runs operator commands under its own contract: Idempotency-Key (a UUID) required; expectedVersion where the subject is versioned (the change happens only at that version, else 409 VERSION_CONFLICT); R3 commands require X-CF-Approver, X-CF-Approval-Ref and X-CF-Intent-Digest (403 APPROVAL_REQUIRED); the applied command is recorded in organization_admin_operations in the same transaction and read back with GET /internal/v1/operator/operations/{idempotencyKey}; a repeated key answers the current state without applying again (another command or subject: 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT); the answer is BridgeCommandResult {status, version (string or null), resource}. Shared routes (organization create, suspend / reactivate / archive, owner recovery, provisioning retry, event replay) keep their answers for every other caller; the staff changes POST /internal/v1/admin/organizations/{id}/members/{membershipId}/change, .../teams/{teamId}/change, .../policies/change and .../scopes/primary/service-bindings/{service}/change are the bridge's alone. New error code APPROVAL_REQUIRED. 1.11.0 (ADR 0068 phase A4, owner-delivered exports): the admin bridge's R4 POST /internal/v1/admin/organizations/{id}/exports (adminRequestOrganizationExport: Idempotency-Key, two-person approval, recorded; HQ gets a reference only — exportId, state, delivery OWNER_DELIVERED, deliveryChannel DOWNLOAD_LINK_EMAIL, deliveryRef, recipientMasked null, expiresAt, sizeBytes, sha256); the export is kept encrypted for 7 days and delivered to the organization's ACTIVE OWNERs as single-use links by email through the Notification Service; the owner's POST /internal/v1/organizations/{id}/exports/{exportId}/download; the bridge's reads GET /internal/v1/operator/organizations/{id}/exports and .../exports/{exportId}; the operator export GET /internal/v1/admin/organizations/{id}/export refused to the admin bridge. New error codes EXPORT_DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE, EXPORT_NO_RECIPIENT, EXPORT_LINK_INVALID, EXPORT_LINK_EXPIRED.

post.summary: Create an organization (the acting user becomes OWNER)
post.description: Creates an ACTIVE organization (creationSource SELF_SERVICE, provisioningState PENDING) with the acting user as its first OWNER (joinedVia CREATOR). Per-actor creation limit: 5 per 24 hours (429 RATE_LIMITED), counted in the database. Writes an audit event and the organization.created / membership.activated outbox events in the same transaction.

patch.description: Requires organization.members.manage. ADMINs cannot manage OWNER / ADMIN memberships nor assign OWNER / ADMIN; nobody raises their own role or changes their own status (use leave). post.description: ACTIVE to SUSPENDED (idempotent). By an OWNER (organization.write + acting user; reason OWNER_REQUEST) or by an operator holding organization.administer without an acting user (reason OPERATOR_ACTION). A suspended organization grants nothing but organization.read to its OWNERs. Emits organization.suspended. Admin bridge (R3): Idempotency-Key and the approval headers required, expectedVersion (the organization's version) required; answers BridgeCommandResult (status ACTIVE / SUSPENDED / ARCHIVED, the organization's version); recorded in organization_admin_operations.

put.description: Create or replace the binding. Organizations stores identifiers only (never a credential value) and does not verify them: Platform Access re-verifies the credential against the organization's triple on every forwarded request, so a wrong binding can only refuse. Repeating the recorded ids is a no-op (same version, nothing audited); expectedVersion (0 = none yet) guards replacement (409 VERSION_CONFLICT). Refused while the organization has no recorded triple (409 PROVISIONING_PENDING) and for ARCHIVED organizations (409 ORGANIZATION_ARCHIVED). A relayed acting user is recorded as boundBy. Audited (scope.service_binding_set). Records an OPERATOR binding (break-glass), which automation never replaces; refused with 409 VERSION_CONFLICT while the revocation of a previous automatic binding is still being applied.

Staff may change every section, delegatedAdministration included; updatedBy is null. An archived organization is refused. Answers UPDATED (or UNCHANGED) with the revision; resource.changedKeys lists the changed policy keys.

post.summary: Set or clear a service binding (admin bridge)
post.description: The admin bridge's binding change (R3, two people; cfmeet.admin-bridge only), at the binding's version (0 = none): SET records the OPERATOR binding (the PUT rules: archived 409, no recorded triple 409 PROVISIONING_PENDING, a pending revocation 409 VERSION_CONFLICT; the same ids are a no-op), CLEAR removes it (the DELETE rules: an AUTOMATIC binding is revoked at Platform Access). Answers BOUND with the binding's version, or REMOVED / REVOKED with version null (the next SET expects 0). Platform Access ids are not echoed. Credential rotation is not offered to the bridge.

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: The bound service (any other value: 404 NOT_FOUND).

get.summary: Read back an admin bridge command (admin bridge)
get.description: The admin bridge's settlement read of a command it sent (ADR 0068 A3.0): the record written in the command's own transaction, with the status and version the command answered. Requires organization.administer and X-CF-Operator; any other caller and an unknown key get 404 NOT_FOUND (a key that is not recorded was never applied).

401.description: Missing, invalid or replayed service token (INTERNAL_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED).

403.description: INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED (no organization.administer) or ACTOR_NOT_ALLOWED (operator attribution malformed or not from cfmeet.admin-bridge).

404.description: NOT_FOUND: unknown key, or not the admin bridge.

post.description: The admin bridge's organizations.organization.export (R4, two people; cfmeet.admin-bridge only). HQ never receives the export: Organizations builds the same document as exportOrganization (it carries invitation addresses), keeps only an XChaCha20-Poly1305 encrypted copy for 7 days, and queues one single-use download link per ACTIVE OWNER (at most 20), sent by email through the Notification Service (organizations.organization.export_ready, the link's token HPKE-sealed to the service; Organizations stores only its SHA-256). The link works once, until expiry, and only for its owner after sign-in (downloadOrganizationExport). Expiry means the command is issued again; nothing is resent. Recorded in organization_admin_operations (subject ORGANIZATION_EXPORT) in the same transaction and audited as organization.export.requested. Answers status READY, version "1" and an OrganizationExportReference. No expectedVersion: the export is a new resource. Off by default (ORGANIZATIONS_EXPORT_DELIVERY_ENABLED; it needs the Notification Service catalogue type): 409 EXPORT_DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE, nothing built or stored.

Answers the export document exactly as stored (the same document as exportOrganization; its SHA-256 in X-CF-Export-Sha256) and uses the link up; the export becomes DELIVERED. Recorded as organization.export.downloaded.

cfServiceAuth.name: X-CF-Service-Authorization
cfServiceAuth.description: Bearer EdDSA service token from packages/service-auth (with X-CF-Request-Id and X-CF-Correlation-Id); audience cfmeet.organizations, runtime environment, expiry, single use and the receiver-granted permission are verified.

ActingUser.name: X-CF-Acting-User
ActingUser.description: The acting user authenticated by the account authority. Honoured only from callers holding organization.act-for-user; from any other caller the request is refused 403 ACTOR_NOT_ALLOWED.

ActingUserRequired.name: X-CF-Acting-User
ActingUserRequired.description: The acting user (required for this operation; 400 VALIDATION_ERROR when absent). Honoured only from callers holding organization.act-for-user.

ActingUserVerifiedEmail.name: X-CF-Acting-User-Verified-Email
ActingUserVerifiedEmail.description: The acting user's verified email (lower-case), for email-bound invitation acceptance. Same caller rule as X-CF-Acting-User.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Replay with the same body returns the stored response (24 h); a different body returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Keyset cursor (nextCursor of the previous page).

Operator.name: X-CF-Operator
Operator.description: The HQ staff member the admin bridge reads for (hq:<staff id>, ADR 0068). Accepted only from cfmeet.admin-bridge; the attribution headers from any other caller are refused on every route (403 ACTOR_NOT_ALLOWED).

BridgeIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
BridgeIdempotencyKey.description: Admin bridge commands only (required from cfmeet.admin-bridge, 400 VALIDATION_ERROR otherwise): HQ's command key, recorded with the change in organization_admin_operations and the key of GET /internal/v1/operator/operations/{idempotencyKey}. Ignored for other callers on shared routes.

BridgeIdempotencyKeyRequired.name: Idempotency-Key
BridgeIdempotencyKeyRequired.description: HQ's command key (a UUID; 400 VALIDATION_ERROR when absent), recorded with the change in organization_admin_operations and the key of GET /internal/v1/operator/operations/{idempotencyKey}.

OperatorOptional.name: X-CF-Operator
OperatorOptional.description: The HQ staff member the admin bridge acts for (hq:<staff id>, ADR 0068): present exactly when the caller is cfmeet.admin-bridge, which then gets the bridge contract (BridgeCommandResult). Refused from any other caller (403 ACTOR_NOT_ALLOWED).

Approver.name: X-CF-Approver
Approver.description: The second person of HQ's two-person approval (a different staff member than X-CF-Operator); with X-CF-Approval-Ref and X-CF-Intent-Digest, all three or none. Required by the admin bridge's R3 and R4 commands (403 APPROVAL_REQUIRED). Accepted only from cfmeet.admin-bridge.

ApprovalRef.name: X-CF-Approval-Ref
ApprovalRef.description: HQ's reference of the single-use approval (recorded as approval_ref). See X-CF-Approver.

IntentDigest.name: X-CF-Intent-Digest
IntentDigest.description: Hex SHA-256 of the approved intent. See X-CF-Approver.

ExportCursor.name: cursor
ExportCursor.description: Keyset cursor (opaque nextCursor of the previous page).

AddTeamMemberRequest.description: Exactly one of membershipId and userId.

AdminBindingChangeRequest.description: SET needs serviceAccountId and credentialId; CLEAR takes neither.

AdminMemberChangeRequest.description: role and / or status (at least one).

expectedVersion.description: The policy revision (0 = never stored: the defaults).

policy.description: A partial PolicyDocument merged into the current one and validated strictly (as UpdatePolicyRequest.policy).

AdminTeamChangeRequest.description: name and / or description, or status ARCHIVED alone.

accountId.description: The CF Meet account asking to install.

appId.description: The app (OAuth client id = Platform Access application id).

reason.description: Present only when allowed is false. NOT_A_MEMBER also covers unknown organizations and suspended or removed memberships (non-enumerating); ORGANIZATION_NOT_READY: the organization is not ACTIVE or its technical provisioning is not READY.

expectedVersion.description: The version of the user's current (non-removed) membership, 0 when they have none. Required from the admin bridge; checked when given (409 VERSION_CONFLICT).

BridgeCommandResult.description: The admin bridge's answer to a command: the resulting state (UPPER_SNAKE), the resulting row version as a string of the integer (null when the subject is unversioned) and a small closed object of ids, states and timestamps (never a name, email or credential value). Organization: lifecycleStatus (ACTIVE, SUSPENDED, ARCHIVED). Membership: status (ACTIVE, SUSPENDED, REMOVED). Team: status (ACTIVE, ARCHIVED). Policy: UPDATED or UNCHANGED with the revision. Binding: BOUND with its version, REMOVED or REVOKED (version null). Provisioning retry: the provisioningState (version null). Event replay: REPLAYED (version null). Organization export (owner-delivered): READY with version "1" and an OrganizationExportReference as resource.

BridgeEmptyRequest.description: The admin bridge sends an empty object (the subject has no version HQ holds).

BridgeOperationRecord.description: The settlement record of an admin bridge command (ADR 0068 A3.0): the same status and version the command answered.

inviteeHint.description: Optional display hint stored instead of the masked email (inviteeEmailHint) for an invitation addressed by another identifier; the Meeting Service sends `CF Meet ID <id>` so the invitee's email is never disclosed to the inviter, even masked. 1.4.0.

inviteeUserId.description: The invitee's CF Meet account when the caller already resolved it (the Meeting Service does for invitations addressed by CF Meet ID). The invitee can then list and answer the invitation in the product, and the invitation.created notification reaches them.

CreateOrganizationRequest.description: No user id, role or tenant is accepted from the body: the acting user is the signed X-CF-Acting-User.

Error.description: Error envelope (Cache-Control: no-store). Messages never contain a token, an email address or database text.

teamId.description: Team context: with organization.teams.manage a MANAGER is allowed only as that team's TEAM_MANAGER.

EvaluateResponse.description: A non-member (or unknown organization) gets NOT_A_MEMBER with null organizationStatus and role (non-enumerating). POLICY_RESTRICTED: the role holds the capability but the organization policy removes it.

EventDeliveryDestination.description: Delivery state of one consumer of organization events (no payloads).

destination.description: One consumer (all consumers when absent). Never cfmeet.reconciliation.

eventIds.description: Only these events (all dead-lettered events when empty).

ImportReport.description: imported / unchanged count rows (organizations + memberships); a differing row is reported in conflicts and never overwritten.

Invitation.description: An invitation; never the email address or the token.

token.description: The one-time invitation token (returned only here; only its SHA-256 is stored). An idempotent replay re-issues a fresh token for a still-pending invitation.

InvitationCreated.description: The created invitation and its one-time token.

nextCursor.description: The cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

LegalRegistration.description: Optional legal registration; SELF_DECLARED until an operator verifies it. createdAt of the organization is never an incorporation date.

LifecycleRequest.description: Optional body; an empty body is accepted.

MigrationExport.description: Meeting Service export (contract section 5). Checksum: SHA-256 (lower-case hex) over UTF-8 lines each followed by \n: org|{id}|{sha256hex(name)}|{slug}|{status}|{createdBy or -}|{createdAt unix microseconds} sorted by id, then mem|{id}|{organizationId}|{userId}|{role}|{status}|{createdAt unix microseconds} sorted by id. Test vector: one organization 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 'Acme Health' acme-health ACTIVE createdBy null createdAt 2026-10-04T12:00:00Z and one OWNER ACTIVE membership 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000b1 of user 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a1 with the same createdAt give 1a212f81add323e1e9bed715699c0ba8c97b2dc22e211c84a05bca42d0908e78.

Organization.description: An organization. Imported legacy slugs keep the Meeting Service rule; new and changed slugs follow the contract pattern.

OrganizationExportDelivery.description: One OWNER's single-use download link, by reference only (never the recipient, the address, the token or the link). PENDING: the notice is being relayed to the Notification Service; SENT: acknowledged; CLAIMED: the owner downloaded the export; FAILED: the notice could not be delivered; EXPIRED: unused at expiry.

OrganizationExportDownloadRequest.description: The token of the owner's emailed link (never logged, stored only as its SHA-256).

OrganizationExportReference.description: An owner-delivered export as HQ sees it (ADR 0068 A4): ids, states, size, digest and times only. Never the document, a token, a sealed part, a URL or an address. state: READY (stored encrypted, links queued or sent), DELIVERED (an owner downloaded it), EXPIRED (unused at expiresAt, 7 days after createdAt), FAILED (no owner could be notified); REQUESTED is reserved (the document is built in the command's transaction). deliveryRef is the first entry of deliveries (one per ACTIVE OWNER, at most 20). recipientMasked is always null: Organizations holds no address (the Notification Service resolves each owner's verified address). sizeBytes and sha256 describe the clear document the owner downloads. purgedAt: when the encrypted copy was removed (at expiry, on FAILED, or once every link is settled). version (reads only): the export row version.

OrganizationExportReferenceList.description: A page of export references, newest first.

legacyMeetingProfilePolicy.description: The Meeting Service profile_policy JSON, verbatim (still enforced by the Meeting Service).

expectedVersion.description: The organization's version (bumped by the transfer).

PolicyDocument.description: Organization-level constraints (schema version 1). Defaults equal the Section 3 role matrix. A policy only removes capabilities and never touches OWNER administration.

visibility.description: Who may list members (organization.members.read). Default MEMBERS.

searchable.description: Colleague discovery hint for the Communications Hub. Default true.

invitationsAllowed.description: GUEST invitations created or accepted. Default true.

hostCreation.description: Who may host organization meetings (meetings.organization.create). Default MEMBERS.

features.description: A disabled feature removes its capabilities for every role. Defaults true.

apps.description: ADR 0064 workspace app installs (only while ORGANIZATIONS_APP_INSTALLS_ENABLED; absent when never set: the defaults apply).

installTier.description: Who may install an app for the organization. Default ADMINS (ADMIN and OWNER); MEMBERS admits MEMBER and above (never GUEST).

allowList.description: null (default): any app; otherwise only these app ids (Developer Console app = Platform Access application id).

userInstallsAllowed.description: Whether members may connect apps to their own accounts (a hint for the account authority). Default true.

ProfileInput.description: Profile fields. On PATCH an absent field is unchanged and null clears it; legalRegistration replaces the whole registration and is always SELF_DECLARED.

provisioningEnabled.description: Whether the Section 7 saga runs (ORGANIZATIONS_PROVISIONING_ENABLED, default false). While false organizations stay PENDING.

Reconciliation.description: Counts, the checksum of the imported rows in their current state (export algorithm), the last import and mismatches (CHECKSUM_MISMATCH, ORGANIZATION_COUNT_MISMATCH, MEMBERSHIP_COUNT_MISMATCH, IMPORT_CONFLICTS).

serviceBindings.description: Operator-recorded service bindings inside this triple (ids only; Platform Access re-verifies them at use). Section 12 follow-up; Messaging added in 1.3.0.

ScopeMapping.description: The organization's technical scope mapping (ids and verification state only; Platform Access stays the tenant authority).

source.description: AUTOMATIC: created and verified by the provisioning saga (ADR 0058 A2); OPERATOR: recorded with PUT (break-glass), never replaced by automation.

verifiedAt.description: Last server-side verification of an AUTOMATIC binding against Platform Access (null for OPERATOR bindings).

credentialExpiresAt.description: Expiry of the bound credential as Platform Access reported it (AUTOMATIC bindings; renewed by reconciliation before expiry).

serviceAccountId.description: Platform Access service account in the organization's triple (non-nil).

credentialId.description: Platform Access credential of that service account (id only, never a secret; non-nil).

expectedVersion.description: Current binding version; 0 = no binding yet.

policy.description: A partial PolicyDocument merged into the current one.

parentTeamId.description: null detaches the team from its parent; absent leaves it unchanged.

Viewer.description: The acting user's membership and effective capabilities (present only for actor reads).
